Cairo Highway Fuel Tanker Crash Kills 31

articles.headline: US Imposes 25% Tariffs on India and Multiple Nations
articles.brief: The United States has announced a fresh trade offensive targeting India and 13 other economies with proposed tariffs of up to 25%. Indian officials emphasize their continued commitment to forging a bilateral trade agreement despite the new hurdles.

articles.headline: India and China Hold High-Level Border Management Talks
articles.brief: India and China have held high-level diplomatic talks in the Arunachal sector to address critical border management and LAC issues, according to the Ministry of External Affairs.

articles.headline: Indian Rupee Hits 8-Month High, Wiping Out Annual Losses
articles.brief: The Indian rupee surged 72 paise to close at 92.23 against the US dollar, driven by strong foreign portfolio inflows reaching a record $14.3 billion and lower crude oil prices.

articles.headline: Poundland Collapses Into Administration, Risking 11,000 Jobs
articles.brief: Major discount retail chain Poundland has fallen into administration after its corporate owners failed to secure a viable buyer, placing 11,000 jobs across the UK at immediate risk.

articles.headline: Cairo Highway Tanker Crash and Massive Fire Kills 31
articles.brief: A tragic accident occurred on a busy ring road in Greater Cairo when a fuel tanker overturned and burst into flames, leaving 31 dead and 21 others injured.

articles.headline: US Approves SpaceX Plan for One Million Data Satellites
articles.brief: US regulators have approved SpaceX's ambitious Starmind constellation plan to launch a million data satellites into space, aiming to create an energy-efficient infrastructure for AI computing power.

articles.headline: Duran Duran Guitarist Andy Taylor Passes Away at Age 65
articles.brief: Andy Taylor, the iconic lead guitarist of new wave band Duran Duran who helped craft their early 1980s hits, has died at the age of 65 following a battle with prostate cancer.

articles.headline: India Overtakes Vietnam to Claim Top Emerging Market Spot
articles.brief: India surpassed Vietnam in October to reclaim the top ranking among emerging markets despite trailing across several high-frequency indicators tracked by analysts.
